'''19''' ('''nineteen''') is the [[natural number]] following [[18 (number)|18]] and preceding [[20 (number)|20]]. It is a [[prime number]].

== Mathematics ==
[[File:Centered triangular number 19.svg|thumb|19 is a [[centered triangular number]].|150px]]

19 is the eighth [[prime number]]. 19 forms a [[twin prime]] pair with [[17 (number)|17]],<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A006512 |Greater of twin primes. |access-date=2022-08-05 }}</ref> a [[cousin prime]] pair with [[23 (number)|23]],<ref>{{Cite OEIS |A088762 |Numbers n such that (2n-1, 2n+3) is a cousin prime pair. |access-date=2022-08-05 }}</ref> and a [[sexy prime]] pair with [[13 (number)|13]].<ref>{{Cite OEIS |A046117 |Primes p such that p-6 is also prime. (Upper of a pair of sexy primes.) |access-date=2022-08-05 }}</ref> 19 is a strictly non-[[palindromic number]] in any [[Numeral system|base]], 19 is the maximum number of fourth powers needed to sum up to any natural number (see, [[Waring's problem]]).<ref>{{Cite OEIS |A002804 |(Presumed) solution to Waring's problem. |access-date=2022-08-05 }}</ref> There are 19 [[Composition (combinatorics)|compositions]] of [[8]] into distinct parts.<ref>{{Cite OEIS |A032020 |Number of compositions of n such that no two adjacent parts are equal (Carlitz compositions). |access-date=2024-07-14 }}</ref>

There are 19 [[Vertex (graph theory)|nodes]] in [[regular hexagon]] with all [[diagonal]]s drawn is nineteen.<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A007569|Number of nodes in regular n-gon with all diagonals drawn.|access-date=2023-04-04}}</ref> The only nontrivial [[magic hexagon|normal magic hexagon]] is composed of nineteen cells, where every diagonal of consecutive hexagons has sums equal to [[38 (number)|38]], or twice 19.<ref>{{Cite magazine |author=Trigg, C. W. |date=February 1964 |title=A Unique Magic Hexagon |url=http://www.mathematik.uni-bielefeld.de/~sillke/PUZZLES/magic-hexagon-trigg |access-date=2022-07-14 |magazine=Recreational Mathematics Magazine}}</ref> A [[Flexagon#Hexahexaflexagon|hexaflexagon]] is a strip of nineteen alternating triangular faces that can ''flex'' into a regular hexagon, such that any two of six colorings on triangles can be oriented to align on opposite sides of the folded figure.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Gardner |first1=Martin |author-link=Martin Gardner |date=January 2012 |title=Hexaflexagons |journal=[[The College Mathematics Journal]] |publisher=[[Taylor & Francis]] |volume=43 |issue=1 |pages=2–5 |doi=10.4169/college.math.j.43.1.002 |jstor=10.4169/college.math.j.43.1.002 |s2cid=218544330}}</ref>

<math>\tfrac {1} {19}</math> can be used to generate the first full, non-normal [[prime reciprocal magic square]] in decimal whose rows, columns ''and'' diagonals — in a 18 x 18 array — all generate a magic constant of [[81 (number)|81]] = 9<sup>2</sup>.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Andrews |first=William Symes |url=http://djm.cc/library/Magic_Squares_Cubes_Andrews_edited.pdf |title=Magic Squares and Cubes |edition=2nd |publisher=[[Open Court Publishing Company]] |year=1917 |location=Chicago, IL |pages=176, 177 |mr=0114763 |oclc=1136401 |zbl=1003.05500}}</ref>

=== Abstract Algebra ===

19 is a [[Supersingular prime (moonshine theory)|supersingular prime]], a member in the sequence of fifteen such primes that divide the [[Order (group theory)|order]] of the [[Monster group|Friendly Giant]] <math>\mathrm {F_{1}}</math>.<ref>{{Cite OEIS |A002267 |The 15 supersingular primes. |access-date=2022-12-11 }}</ref> Additionally, 19 also divides the orders of the [[Janko group]]s <math>\mathrm {J_{1}}</math> and <math>\mathrm {J_{3}}</math>.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Ronan |first1=Mark |author-link=Mark Ronan |title=Symmetry and the Monster: One of the Greatest Quests of Mathematics |publisher=[[Oxford University Press]] |location=New York |year=2006 |pages=244–246 |isbn=978-0-19-280722-9 |oclc=180766312 |doi=10.1007/s00283-008-9007-9 |doi-access=free |mr=2215662 |zbl=1113.00002 }}</ref>

19 is a [[Heegner number]].<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A003173|heegner numbers}}</ref>

==Science==
[[File:JWST spacecraft model 3.png|thumb|The [[James Webb Space Telescope]] features a design of 19 hexagons.|140px]]
* The [[James Webb Space Telescope]]'s optical elements are in an array of 19 hexagons, wherein 18 segmented primary mirrors focus light into a centered secondary mirror situated above the collecting mirrors, that in-turn reflects back onto the telescope's central [[Image sensor|imagers]]. It is a shape akin to the order-3 magic hexagon.
* The [[Metonic cycle]] is almost exactly 19 years long.

==Music==
*Nineteen has been used as an alternative to twelve for a division of the octave into equal parts. This idea goes back to [[Francisco de Salinas|Salinas]] in the sixteenth century, and is interesting in part because it gives a system of [[meantone]] tuning, being close to 1/3 comma meantone. ''See [[19 equal temperament]].''
*Some organs use the 19th harmonic to approximate a minor third.{{cn|date=October 2024}}

==Religion==
===Islam===
* The number of angels [[Zabaniyah|guarding]] [[Hell]] ("Hellfire") ("Saqar") according to the [[Qur'an]]: "Over it are nineteen" ([[al-Muddaththir|74]]:30),<ref name="Suyuti fingers">{{cite book |author1=Al-Suyuti |author1-link=Al-Suyuti |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=iDxQEAAAQBAJ |title=Misteri Alam Malaikat |date=2021 |publisher=Pustaka al-Kautsar |isbn=9789795929512 |editor1-last=Muhammad as Said Basyuni |editor1-first=Abu Hajir |pages=29–33, 72, 172 |language=id |translator=Mishabul Munir |type=Religion / Islam / General |access-date=6 February 2022 |editor2-last=Yasir |editor2-first=Muhammad}} Reference from: {{cite book |author1=Abu Muhammad Abdullah bin Muslim ibn Qutayba al-Dinawari |author1-link=Ibn Qutaybah |url=https://shamela.ws/book/23790 |title=Uyun al-Akhbar |date=1994 |publisher=Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyyah |language=Ar |access-date=26 August 2024}}</ref> after which the Qur'an describes this number as being "a trial for those who disbelieve" (74:31), a sign for people of the scripture to be "convinced" (74:31) and that believers "will increase in faith" (74:31) due to it.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Surah Al-Muddaththir - 30-31 |url=https://quran.com/en/al-muddaththir/30-31 |access-date=2025-02-10 |website=Quran.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Blog |first=Quran Talk |date=2020-09-17 |title=19 Angels or 19 Miracle |url=https://qurantalkblog.com/2020/09/17/19-angels-or-19-miracle/ |access-date=2025-02-10 |work=Quran Talk Blog}}</ref>
* The Number of Verse and Sura together in the Qur'an which announces Jesus son of Maryam's (Mary's) birth (Qur'an 19:19).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Surah Maryam - 19 |url=https://quran.com/en/maryam/19 |access-date=2025-02-10 |website=Quran.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Sabah |first=Nassir |date=2024-05-27 |title=Mary, Jesus, and the Number 19 in the Quran |url=https://medium.com/@nsabah19/mary-jesus-and-the-number-19-in-the-quran-63a45963a601 |access-date=2025-02-10 |work=Medium}}</ref>

===Baháʼí Faith===
In the [[Bábism|Bábí]] and [[Baháʼí Faith]]s, a group of 19 is called a ''Váhid'', a Unity ({{Langx|ar|واحد|lit=one|translit=wāhid}}). The numerical value of this word in the [[Abjad numerals|Abjad numeral system]] is 19.
* The [[Baháʼí calendar]] is structured such that a year contains 19 months of 19 days each (along with the [[Intercalation (timekeeping)|intercalary]] period of [[Ayyám-i-Há]]), as well as a 19-year cycle and a 361-year (19x19) supercycle.
*The [[Báb]] and his [[Letters of the Living|disciples]] formed a group of 19.
*There were 19 [[Apostles of Bahá'u'lláh]].

===Celtic paganism===
19 is a sacred number of the goddess [[Brigid]] because it is said to represent the [[Metonic cycle|19-year cycle]] of the Great Celtic Year and the amount of time it takes the Moon to coincide with the winter solstice.<ref>[https://www.mimosaspirit.com/blogs/news/brigit-triple-goddess-of-the-flame-health-hearth-the-forge Brigid: Triple Goddess of the Flame (Health, Hearth, & Forge)]</ref>

==Literature==
[[Stephen King]]'s eight-book epic [[The Dark Tower (series)|''The Dark Tower'']] saga employs the number 19 in books ''[[The Dark Tower: The Gunslinger]]'', ''[[The Dark Tower V: Wolves of the Calla]]'', ''[[The Dark Tower VI: Song of Susannah]]'', ''[[The Dark Tower VII: The Dark Tower]]'', and ''[[The Wind Through the Keyhole]]'' as a mysterious and important number. They refer to the "ka-tet of 19", "Directive Nineteen," many names add up to 19, 19 seems to permeate every aspect of Roland and his traveler's lives. In addition, the number ends up being a powerful key.

==Games==
Though the maximum score for a [[cribbage]] hand is 29, there is no combination of cards that adds up to 19 points. Many cribbage players, therefore, jokingly refer to a zero-point hand as "a 19 hand".

==In sports==
In [[golf]], the '19th hole' is the clubhouse bar and in match play, if there is a tie after 18 holes, an extra hole(s) is played. In [[miniature golf]], it is an extra hole on which the winner earns an instant prize.

==Age 19==
*In four countries ([[Algeria]], [[South Korea]], United States ([[Alabama]] and [[Nebraska]]), and [[Canada]]), 19 is the [[age of majority]].
*In two countries (South Korea and Canada), 19 is the minimum [[legal drinking age]].
*In three countries (Algeria, South Korea, and Canada), 19 is the minimum [[legal smoking age]].
*The minimum age for the [[NBA draft]] is 19 years old.
